newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dlr ends stable despite S.Africa news.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dlr ends stable despite S.Africa news.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed little changed against its U.S. counterpart on Thursday despite South Africa's decision to switch diplomatic recognition to Beijing from Taipei at the end of 1997, dealers said.
The local unit finished at T$27.490 against Wednesday's T$27.489 close. Turnover was US$200 million.

Dealers said Pretoria's decision, under pressure from China, was not surprising and did not affect the foreign exchange market. "The market did not react to the news today and I don't think it will," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
China has regarded Taiwan as a Chinese province not entitled to foreign ties since a civil war separated them in 1949.
Under international isolation, only 30 countries recognise Taiwan's Republic of China government.
Dealers saw a T$27.48-T$27.50 trading range in the near term. -- Joyce Liu (2-5080815)
